custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an inactive part for this test, part A, and an active part for this test, part B.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C839491 PART A in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839491-A in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, type 5 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save. Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C839491 PART B in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839491-B in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, type 5 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save.
  • Have a canned job, canned job 1, that holds part A and part B.
    • How to do it: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order; pick any Customer and any Asset, then click Save. The New Line window opens by itself: type ZZAUTOTEST PL C839491 LINE C in Title and press Tab, pick any Labor Rate, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close. Add p, a, r, t, s, , A, , a, n, d, , B to that line, one of each: in the line's Parts row click + Add Part, type the part number in Part number, pick the result that shows Inventory Qty, type 1 in Qty *, then click Save. Then click the three-dot icon on the line, click Save as canned line, type ZZAUTOTEST PL C839491 CANNED JOB A in Line Title and click Save As Canned Line. Then set part A inactive: On the Inventory page click Search, type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839491-A, click its row, click Inactive under Part Status, click Save, then click Deactivate in the Deactivate part? window.
  • Create an open work order for this test, work order 1, with one line.
    • How to do it: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order; pick any Customer and any Asset, then click Save. The New Line window opens by itself: type ZZAUTOTEST PL C839491 LINE 1 in Title and press Tab, pick any Labor Rate, then click Save & Close.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1600 pixels wide with the page zoom at 100%, so the screen is as wide as the design boards.
  • Open the attached design pictures of boards 6.4 and 6.5 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with them.
  • Start on the Work Orders page.
